verdict.rationale: Docs show enterprise-tier controls (SSO, domain capture, role-based permissions, managed policy settings for org-wide configurations), a sandboxed Bash tool where admins define exactly which files/network domains commands can touch, and the Agent SDK giving 'full control over orchestration, tool access, and permissions' — all directly supporting an engineering-lead's ability to govern which tools/integrations Claude Code can use.  Missing for 10: explicit UI/CLI documentation of an MCP-server allow/deny list per integration, and independent (non-vendor) verification that these controls work as described in practice.
